meta.experiment: Track D re-run: 4x4 K2P+N scoping enumeration (post-outage re-run, 2026-11-15)
meta.method: pure analytic enumeration over the 91,404 K2P placements; no oracle build; exact counts (no sampling)
meta.board: 4x4, K2P conventions (kings non-adjacent, <=2 pawns/side on band y in 1..2, kings off pawns) + knights on any free square

legality_variants.repo_legal (primary): side NOT to move is not attacked by enemy pawns or enemy knights (K2P rule extended to the added piece type); the count the retrograde oracle would accept
legality_variants.structural_raw: constraints as listed in the resume instruction only (no check rule); both tempos counted

assumptions: pawn cap stays 0-2 per side (K2P material plus knights)
knights unrestricted to band/back ranks (any free square)
kings non-adjacent by construction; K-K, K-P, P-P, knight-square exclusions shared from the K2P placement pool
no knight-vs-own-side constraints beyond square occupancy
the 9-class K2P family partition does NOT cover K2P+N: new material classes (knight counts) would need their own family routing in the compressor
meta.feasibility_scaling: build wall ~ 110.5 s x (states/6,744,724); build RSS ~ 2.37 GiB x (states/6,744,724); 4 GiB sandbox guard ~3.4 GiB (the guard that killed the first N=5 full-space attempt)
